description: This file contains unit tests for the WebSocket transport component of a pipeline processing framework. It tests websocket handling, frame processing, connection decorators, and serializer options.

classes.name: TestWebSocketTransportService
classes.description: Unit test class for WebSocket transport service, testing connection handling, frame processing, and serialization.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, setting up WebSocket transport, pipeline, and sample frames.

methods.name: queue_frame
methods.description: Coroutine to simulate queueing frames after a delay.

methods.name: test_websocket_handler
methods.description: Tests the websocket handler's ability to send serialized frames.

methods.name: test_on_connection_decorator
methods.description: Verifies that the on_connection decorator correctly registers the connection handler.

methods.name: test_frame_processor
methods.description: Tests the frame processor for correct splitting and type handling.

methods.name: test_serializer_parameter
methods.description: Checks that custom serializers are correctly used in the websocket handler.
